exit.bounded_conclusion: Current governed scalar/path summaries and the existing broad-path-disorder composite do not provide an independent positive compact-disorder proposition that separates the consumed compact Stage0 packet from Stage2. A sequential range-envelope/failed-resolution observable is a plausible hypothesis, but consumed data show overlap and cannot authorize a new Fact. Synthetic counterexamples and threshold-free prototype semantics are required before the D decision fork.
